contextBlurb: Idaho is leaning restrictive across both data centers and AI. On data centers: H0895 (enacted) — Sets limits on how much water data centers in Idaho can use for cooling purposes. On AI: H0727 (enacted) — Strengthens penalties for creating and sharing explicit synthetic media (deepfakes), treating such content as a criminal offense.

legislation.title: Amends existing law to revise a sales tax exemption for data center equipment and to revise a certain property tax exemption for certain capital investments.
legislation.summary: This bill updates Idaho's tax exemptions for data center equipment and related capital investments, making it easier and cheaper to build and operate data centers in the state. It is a pro-industry measure designed to attract data center development through tax relief.

legislation.title: Adds to existing law to establish limitations on consumptive use of water for cooling certain data centers.
legislation.summary: This bill sets limits on how much water data centers in Idaho can use for cooling purposes. It restricts the consumptive use of water by data centers, aiming to conserve water resources in the state.

legislation.title: Adds to existing law to establish the Conversational AI Safety Act.
legislation.summary: This bill establishes safety requirements for conversational AI systems, likely including disclosure and transparency rules for chatbots and virtual assistants. It aims to protect users, potentially including minors, from harms associated with AI-driven conversations.

legislation.title: Amends existing law to revise a provision regarding video voyeurism and to revise a penalty for disclosing explicit synthetic media.
legislation.summary: This bill strengthens penalties for creating and sharing explicit synthetic media (deepfakes), treating such content as a criminal offense. It addresses both video voyeurism and non-consensual intimate imagery created using AI or digital manipulation techniques.

legislation.title: Adds to existing law to establish provisions regarding artifical intelligence medical services.
legislation.summary: Idaho legislation establishing provisions for artificial intelligence use in medical services. The bill addresses regulatory framework and oversight for AI-driven healthcare applications.

legislation.title: Adds to existing law to establish provisions regarding generative artificial intelligence in public education.
legislation.summary: This bill creates new rules governing how generative AI tools can be used in Idaho's public schools. It sets standards and requirements that schools must follow when incorporating AI into education.

legislation.title: Adds to existing law to require the use of AI to review administrative rules annually.
legislation.summary: This bill requires Idaho to use artificial intelligence to review the state's administrative rules every year. It aims to make the rule-review process more efficient by automating analysis of existing regulations.

legislation.title: Amends existing law to revise a sales tax exemption for data center equipment and to revise a certain property tax exemption for certain capital investments.
legislation.summary: This bill updates Idaho's tax exemptions for data center equipment and related capital investments, making it easier or more beneficial for data centers to operate in the state. It is a pro-industry measure aimed at attracting or retaining data center investment through tax relief.

legislation.title: Adds to existing law to establish provisions regarding unbiased artificial intelligence in state government purchasing.
legislation.summary: This bill sets rules requiring that artificial intelligence used in Idaho state government purchasing decisions be unbiased. It establishes standards to ensure AI tools don't discriminate when the state is buying goods or services.

legislation.title: Adds to existing law to establish provisions regarding the capture or use of biometric identifiers.
legislation.summary: This bill establishes new rules in Idaho law governing how biometric identifiers — such as fingerprints, face scans, or iris scans — can be collected and used. It creates legal protections around the capture and use of this sensitive personal data.

legislation.summary: This bill updates Idaho's tax exemptions for data center equipment and certain capital investments, making it easier and cheaper to build and equip data centers in the state. It is a pro-industry measure designed to attract data center investment through tax relief.
